name: Prime Number
statement: A natural number p >= 2 whose only divisors are 1 and p.

name: Greatest Common Divisor
statement: gcd(a,b) is the largest natural number dividing both a and b.

name: Coprime Integers
statement: a and b are coprime if gcd(a,b) = 1.

name: Modular Congruence
statement: a ≡ b (mod n) iff n divides a - b.

name: Ring ZMod n
statement: ZMod n is the ring of integers modulo n.

name: Euler's Totient Function
statement: phi(n) counts integers 1 <= k <= n coprime to n.

name: Legendre Symbol
statement: (a/p) = 1 if a is a QR mod p, -1 if not, 0 if p | a.

name: Moebius Function
statement: mu(n) = (-1)^k if n is product of k distinct primes, 0 if n has squared prime factor.

name: p-adic Valuation
statement: v_p(n) is the largest power of prime p dividing n.

name: Primitive Root
statement: g is a primitive root mod n if its multiplicative order equals phi(n).

name: Fermat's Little Theorem
statement: If p is prime and gcd(a,p) = 1, then a^{p-1} ≡ 1 (mod p).

name: Euler's Theorem
statement: If gcd(a,n) = 1 then a^{phi(n)} ≡ 1 (mod n).

name: Wilson's Theorem
statement: p >= 2 is prime iff (p-1)! ≡ -1 (mod p).

name: Chinese Remainder Theorem
statement: If gcd(m,n) = 1 then ZMod(mn) ≅ ZMod(m) × ZMod(n).

name: Quadratic Reciprocity
statement: For odd primes p,q: (p/q)(q/p) = (-1)^{(p-1)/2·(q-1)/2}.

name: Bezout's Identity
statement: For a,b ∈ Z, there exist x,y with ax + by = gcd(a,b).

name: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
statement: Every integer > 1 has a unique prime factorization.

name: Infinitude of Primes
statement: There are infinitely many prime numbers.

name: Euclid's Lemma
statement: If prime p divides ab, then p divides a or p divides b.

name: Bertrand's Postulate
statement: For every n >= 1, there exists a prime p with n < p <= 2n.

name: Dirichlet's Theorem on Primes in APs
statement: For coprime a,d, there are infinitely many primes ≡ a (mod d).

name: Sum of Two Squares
statement: Odd prime p = a² + b² iff p ≡ 1 (mod 4).

name: Lagrange's Four Squares Theorem
statement: Every positive integer is the sum of four squares.

name: Sum of Totient over Divisors
statement: Σ_{d|n} phi(d) = n for all n >= 1.

name: Chevalley-Warning Theorem
statement: If polynomials over F_p have total degree < number of variables, p divides the number of common zeros.

name: Hensel's Lemma
statement: A simple root mod p lifts uniquely to Z_p.

name: QR Second Supplement
statement: (2/p) = (-1)^{(p²-1)/8}: 2 is a QR mod p iff p ≡ ±1 (mod 8).

name: Lucas' Theorem
statement: C(m,n) ≡ Π C(m_i,n_i) (mod p) where m_i,n_i are base-p digits.

name: Legendre's Formula
statement: v_p(n!) = Σ_{i≥1} floor(n/p^i).

name: Freshman's Dream
statement: In characteristic p: (a + b)^p = a^p + b^p.

name: Finite Field Multiplicative Group is Cyclic
statement: The multiplicative group of any finite field is cyclic.

name: Square Root of 2 is Irrational
statement: √2 is not rational.

name: Pi is Irrational
statement: π is irrational.

name: Lifting the Exponent Lemma
statement: For odd prime p with p | a-b, p ∤ a: v_p(aⁿ - bⁿ) = v_p(a-b) + v_p(n).

name: Order Divides Group Order
statement: In a finite group, ord(g) divides |G|.

name: Finite Set (Finset)
statement: A finite set with decidable membership and cardinality.

name: Binomial Coefficient
statement: C(n,k) = n!/(k!(n-k)!) counts k-element subsets of [n].

name: Simple Graph
statement: G = (V,E) with irreflexive symmetric edge relation.

name: Chromatic Number
statement: χ(G) is the minimum colors for a proper vertex coloring.

name: Antichain
statement: A set of pairwise incomparable elements in a poset.

name: Partition of n
statement: A multiset of positive integers summing to n.

name: Catalan Numbers
statement: C_n = C(2n,n)/(n+1) counts binary trees, Dyck paths, etc.

name: Matroid
statement: A combinatorial structure generalizing linear independence.

name: Graph Matching
statement: A set of pairwise non-adjacent edges.

name: Graph Connectivity
statement: G is connected if every two vertices are joined by a path.

name: Pigeonhole Principle
statement: If n+1 objects go in n boxes, some box has ≥ 2.

name: Binomial Theorem
statement: (x+y)^n = Σ C(n,k) x^{n-k} y^k.

name: Sperner's Theorem
statement: Max antichain in P([n]) has size C(n, ⌊n/2⌋).

name: Erdos-Ko-Rado Theorem
statement: Max intersecting k-uniform family of [n] (n≥2k) has size C(n-1,k-1).

name: Turan's Theorem
statement: Max edges in K_{r+1}-free graph on n vertices is (1-1/r)n²/2.

name: Handshaking Lemma
statement: Sum of degrees = 2 × number of edges.

name: Kruskal-Katona Theorem
statement: Initial segments in colex minimize shadow size among k-uniform families of given size.

name: Vandermonde's Identity
statement: C(m+n,r) = Σ_{k=0}^r C(m,k)C(n,r-k).

name: Zorn's Lemma
statement: If every chain in a poset has an upper bound, there exists a maximal element.

name: Binomial Symmetry
statement: C(n,k) = C(n,n-k).

name: Polynomial Ring
statement: R[X] is the ring of polynomials with coefficients in R.

name: Complex Numbers
statement: ℂ = ℝ × ℝ with multiplication (a,b)(c,d) = (ac-bd, ad+bc).

name: Inner Product Space
statement: A vector space with a positive-definite Hermitian form ⟨·,·⟩.

name: Norm
statement: A function ‖·‖ satisfying positivity, homogeneity, triangle inequality.

name: Algebraic Closure
statement: An algebraically closed field extension in which every polynomial splits.

name: Absolute Value
statement: |x| = x if x ≥ 0, -x if x < 0.

name: Root of Polynomial
statement: r is a root of f if f(r) = 0.

name: Degree of Polynomial
statement: deg(f) is the highest power with nonzero coefficient.

name: Fundamental Theorem of Algebra
statement: Every non-constant polynomial over ℂ has a root in ℂ.

name: AM-GM Inequality
statement: For non-negative reals: (a₁+...+aₙ)/n ≥ (a₁·...·aₙ)^{1/n}.

name: Triangle Inequality
statement: ‖a + b‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ in any normed space.

name: Factor Theorem
statement: r is a root of f iff (x-r) divides f.

name: Power Mean Inequality
statement: M_r(x) ≤ M_s(x) for r ≤ s, where M_r is the r-th power mean.

name: Hilbert Basis Theorem
statement: If R is Noetherian, then R[X] is Noetherian.

name: Polynomial GCD Exists
statement: k[X] is a Euclidean domain, so GCDs exist.

name: Continuous Function
statement: f is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a).

name: Differentiable Function
statement: f is differentiable at a if the limit (f(a+h)-f(a))/h exists.

name: Riemann Integral
statement: ∫_a^b f(x)dx as limit of Riemann sums.

name: Compact Set
statement: A set is compact if every open cover has a finite subcover.

name: Sequence Convergence
statement: aₙ → L if for every ε > 0, |aₙ - L| < ε for sufficiently large n.

name: Series Convergence
statement: Σ aₙ converges if its partial sums converge.

name: Metric Space
statement: A set with a distance function d satisfying positivity, symmetry, triangle inequality.

name: Measure
statement: A countably additive set function μ: Σ → [0,∞].

name: Mean Value Theorem
statement: If f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), ∃c: f'(c) = (f(b)-f(a))/(b-a).

name: Intermediate Value Theorem
statement: A continuous function on [a,b] takes every value between f(a) and f(b).

name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part 1)
statement: If F' = f (continuous), then ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a).

name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part 2)
statement: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x) for continuous f.

name: Rolle's Theorem
statement: If f(a) = f(b) and f is differentiable on (a,b), ∃c: f'(c) = 0.

name: Extreme Value Theorem
statement: A continuous function on a compact set attains its max and min.

name: Monotone Convergence Theorem
statement: If fₙ ↑ f pointwise (non-negative measurable), then ∫fₙ → ∫f.

name: Dominated Convergence Theorem
statement: If fₙ → f a.e. and |fₙ| ≤ g (integrable), then ∫fₙ → ∫f.

name: Squeeze Theorem
statement: If aₙ ≤ bₙ ≤ cₙ and aₙ,cₙ → L, then bₙ → L.

name: Comparison Test for Series
statement: If 0 ≤ aₙ ≤ bₙ and Σbₙ converges, then Σaₙ converges.

name: Ratio Test
statement: If |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| → L < 1, then Σaₙ converges absolutely.

name: Stone-Weierstrass Theorem
statement: A subalgebra of C(X,ℝ) separating points is dense in C(X,ℝ).

name: Inverse Function Theorem
statement: If f'(a) is invertible, then f is a local diffeomorphism near a.

name: Implicit Function Theorem
statement: If F(a,b)=0 and ∂F/∂y is invertible at (a,b), there exists g with F(x,g(x))=0 near a.

name: Heine-Borel Theorem
statement: In ℝⁿ, a set is compact iff closed and bounded.

name: Banach Fixed Point Theorem
statement: A contraction on a complete metric space has a unique fixed point.

name: Angle Between Vectors
statement: The angle θ with cos θ = ⟨u,v⟩/(‖u‖·‖v‖).

name: Convex Set
statement: S is convex if for x,y ∈ S and t ∈ [0,1]: tx + (1-t)y ∈ S.

name: Triangle
statement: Three non-collinear points in an affine space.

name: Pythagorean Theorem
statement: In a right triangle: a² + b² = c².

name: Law of Cosines
statement: c² = a² + b² - 2ab·cos(C).

name: Triangle Inequality
statement: d(x,z) ≤ d(x,y) + d(y,z) in any metric space.

name: Riesz Representation (Hilbert)
statement: Every continuous linear functional on a Hilbert space is ⟨·,y⟩ for unique y.

name: Vector Space
statement: A module over a field.

name: Linear Map
statement: f(αu + βv) = αf(u) + βf(v).

name: Matrix
statement: An m × n array of elements from a ring.

name: Determinant
statement: det(A) = Σ_{σ∈Sₙ} sgn(σ) Π aᵢ,σ(ᵢ).

name: Rank
statement: rank(f) = dim(image(f)) for a linear map f.

name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
statement: dim(V) = rank(f) + nullity(f) for linear f: V → W.

name: Cayley-Hamilton Theorem
statement: Every square matrix satisfies its own characteristic polynomial.

name: Determinant is Multiplicative
statement: det(AB) = det(A)·det(B).

name: Cramer's Rule
statement: xᵢ = det(Aᵢ)/det(A) where Aᵢ replaces column i with b.

name: Every Vector Space Has a Basis
statement: Every vector space (over a division ring) has a basis.

name: Dimension is Well-Defined
statement: All bases of a vector space have the same cardinality.

name: Trace equals Sum of Eigenvalues
statement: tr(A) = Σ λᵢ (counted with multiplicity).

name: Group
statement: A set with associative binary operation, identity, and inverses.

name: Ring
statement: A set with addition (abelian group) and multiplication (monoid) satisfying distributivity.

name: Field
statement: A commutative ring where every nonzero element has a multiplicative inverse.

name: Ideal
statement: A subgroup I of (R,+) with rI ⊆ I for all r ∈ R.

name: Normal Subgroup
statement: N ◁ G if gNg⁻¹ = N for all g ∈ G.

name: Group Homomorphism
statement: f: G → H with f(ab) = f(a)f(b).

name: Galois Group
statement: Aut(E/F) is the group of field automorphisms of E fixing F.

name: Lagrange's Theorem (Groups)
statement: |H| divides |G| for any subgroup H of finite group G.

name: First Isomorphism Theorem
statement: G/ker(f) ≅ im(f) for any group homomorphism f.

name: Sylow's First Theorem
statement: If p^k divides |G|, then G has a subgroup of order p^k.

name: Cauchy's Theorem (Groups)
statement: If prime p divides |G|, then G has an element of order p.

name: Fundamental Theorem of Galois Theory
statement: There is an order-reversing bijection between intermediate fields and subgroups of the Galois group.

name: Second Isomorphism Theorem
statement: (HN)/N ≅ H/(H∩N) for subgroup H and normal N.

name: Class Equation
statement: |G| = |Z(G)| + Σ [G:C_G(gᵢ)] summing over conjugacy class representatives.

name: Primitive Element Theorem
statement: Every finite separable extension is simple: E = F(α) for some α.

name: Totient is Multiplicative
statement: phi(mn) = phi(m)phi(n) when gcd(m,n) = 1.

name: Moebius Inversion Formula
statement: If g(n) = sum_{d|n} f(d) then f(n) = sum_{d|n} mu(n/d)g(d).

name: FLT for n=4
statement: x^4 + y^4 = z^4 has no positive integer solutions.

name: Cyclotomic Polynomial Irreducibility
statement: The n-th cyclotomic polynomial Phi_n(x) is irreducible over Q.

name: Gauss's Lemma (Polynomials)
statement: A primitive polynomial over Z is irreducible over Z iff irreducible over Q.

name: Hall's Marriage Theorem
statement: A bipartite graph has a perfect matching iff |N(S)| >= |S| for all S.

name: Burnside's Lemma
statement: |X/G| = (1/|G|) sum |Fix(g)|.

name: Cauchy-Davenport Theorem
statement: For non-empty A,B subsets of Z/pZ: |A+B| >= min(p, |A|+|B|-1).

name: Plunnecke-Ruzsa Inequality
statement: If |A+A| <= K|A| then |nA-mA| <= K^{n+m}|A|.

name: Young's Inequality
statement: For p,q > 1 with 1/p + 1/q = 1: ab <= a^p/p + b^q/q.

name: Vieta's Formulas
statement: The elementary symmetric polynomials of roots equal (signed) coefficients.

name: L'Hopital's Rule
statement: If f/g -> 0/0 or inf/inf and f'/ g' -> L, then f/g -> L.

name: Alternating Series Test
statement: If a_n >= 0, a_n decreasing to 0, then sum (-1)^n a_n converges.

name: Affine Space
statement: A set with a free transitive action by a vector space.

name: Eigenvalue
statement: lambda is an eigenvalue of A if Av = lambda*v for some v != 0.

name: Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization
statement: Any linearly independent set can be orthogonalized.

name: Invertible iff Nonzero Determinant
statement: A square matrix is invertible iff det(A) != 0.

name: Orbit-Stabilizer Theorem
statement: |Orb(x)| * |Stab(x)| = |G| for a group action.

name: Sylow's Third Theorem
statement: The number of Sylow p-subgroups divides |G| and is congruent to 1 mod p.

name: Jacobi Symbol Reciprocity
statement: For odd a,b: (a/b) = (-1)^(a/2 * b/2) * (b/a) where (a/b) is the Jacobi symbol.

name: PID Characterization
statement: R is a PID iff every ideal of R is principal.

name: UFD Polynomial Ring
statement: If D is a UFD then D[X] is a UFD.

name: Rearrangement Inequality
statement: The sum a_i*b_i is maximized when both sequences are similarly sorted.

name: Weierstrass M-test
statement: If |f_n(x)| <= M_n and sum M_n converges, then sum f_n converges uniformly.

name: Arzela-Ascoli Theorem
statement: Pointwise bounded + equicontinuous family on compact space has compact closure.

name: Fatou Lemma
statement: integral of liminf f_n <= liminf of integral f_n.

name: Fubini Theorem
statement: Integral over product measure equals iterated integral when integrable.

name: Open Mapping Theorem
statement: A surjective bounded linear map between Banach spaces is an open map.

name: Closed Graph Theorem
statement: A linear map between Banach spaces with closed graph is continuous.

name: Spectral Theorem
statement: A Hermitian matrix A = U * diag(eigenvalues) * U* for unitary U.

name: Basis Extension
statement: Every linearly independent set in a vector space can be extended to a basis.

name: Row Rank equals Column Rank
statement: rank(A^T) = rank(A) for any matrix A.

name: Third Isomorphism Theorem
statement: (G/N)/(M/N) is isomorphic to G/M when N is normal in M and M is normal in G.

name: Structure Theorem for Finitely Generated Abelian Groups
statement: Every finitely generated torsion module over a PID is isomorphic to a direct sum of cyclic modules R/(p^e).

name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality
statement: |<x,y>| <= ||x|| * ||y|| in any inner product space.

name: Eisenstein's Criterion
statement: If P is prime, leading coeff not in P, lower coeffs in P, constant not in P^2, and f primitive, then f is irreducible.

name: Angle Sum of Triangle
statement: The sum of angles in a triangle equals pi.

name: Thales' Theorem
statement: An angle inscribed in a semicircle is a right angle.

name: Orthocenter on Altitude
statement: The orthocenter of a triangle lies on every altitude.

name: Circumcenter Equidistant
statement: All vertices of a simplex are equidistant from the circumcenter.

name: AA Similarity
statement: Two triangles with two equal angles are similar.

name: Perpendicular Bisector Equidistant
statement: A point lies on the perpendicular bisector of PQ iff it is equidistant from P and Q.

name: Equilateral Triangle Angle
statement: Each angle of an equilateral triangle equals pi/3.

name: Exterior Angle Theorem
statement: An exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two non-adjacent interior angles.

name: Isometry Preserves Distance
statement: An isometry preserves distances: dist(f(x), f(y)) = dist(x, y).

name: Isometry Preserves Angle
statement: An isometry preserves angles: angle(f(p1), f(p2), f(p3)) = angle(p1, p2, p3).

name: Heron's Formula
statement: Area = sqrt(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)) where s = (a+b+c)/2.

name: Orthocenter
statement: The point where the three altitudes of a triangle meet.

name: Circumcenter
statement: The point equidistant from all vertices of a simplex.

name: Nine-Point Circle
statement: The circle passing through the midpoints of sides, feet of altitudes, and midpoints of segments from vertices to orthocenter.

name: Altitude
statement: The perpendicular from a vertex to the opposite side of a simplex.

name: Incenter
statement: The center of the inscribed circle of a simplex.

name: Centroid
statement: The average (center of mass) of the vertices of a simplex.

name: Carmichael Function
statement: The multiplicative order of units in ZMod n is bounded by the Carmichael function.

name: Units of ZMod
statement: The number of units in ZMod n equals phi(n).

name: Squarefree Moebius
statement: n is squarefree iff mu(n) is nonzero.

name: Tree
statement: A connected acyclic graph.

name: Acyclic Graph
statement: A graph with no cycles.

name: Clique
statement: A set of pairwise adjacent vertices in a graph.

name: Bipartite Graph
statement: A graph whose vertices can be partitioned into two sets with edges only between sets.

name: Connected Component
statement: A maximal connected subgraph.

name: Graph Degree
statement: The number of edges incident to a vertex.

name: Permutation Sign
statement: The sign of a permutation: +1 for even, -1 for odd.

name: Cycle Type
statement: The multiset of cycle lengths of a permutation.

name: Descending Factorial
statement: n^{(k)} = n(n-1)...(n-k+1), the falling factorial.

name: Multinomial Coefficient
statement: n! / (k1! * k2! * ... * km!) counts ways to partition n items into groups.

name: Powerset Cardinality
statement: |P(S)| = 2^|S| for finite set S.

name: Product Rule (Counting)
statement: |A x B| = |A| * |B| for finite sets.

name: Choose Maximized at Middle
statement: C(n,k) is maximized when k = floor(n/2).

name: Polynomial Degree Multiplication
statement: deg(f*g) = deg(f) + deg(g) for nonzero polynomials over a domain.

name: Polynomial Derivative
statement: Formal derivative of a polynomial.

name: Exponential Addition Law
statement: exp(a+b) = exp(a) * exp(b).

name: Log Exp Identity
statement: exp(log(x)) = x for x > 0.

name: Exponential Function
statement: exp(x) = sum x^n/n!, the exponential function.

name: Logarithm Function
statement: log(x) is the inverse of exp on positive reals.

name: Trigonometric Functions
statement: sin and cos defined via exponential: sin(x) = (e^{ix} - e^{-ix})/2i.

name: Euler Formula
statement: e^{ix} = cos(x) + i*sin(x).

name: Binomial Coefficient Positive
statement: C(n,k) > 0 when k <= n.

name: Square Nonnegative
statement: a^2 >= 0 in any linearly ordered semiring.

name: Sum Monotonicity
statement: If f(i) <= g(i) for all i in S, then sum f <= sum g.

name: Product Monotonicity
statement: If 0 <= f(i) <= g(i) for all i, then prod f <= prod g.

name: Noetherian Ring
statement: A ring where every ideal is finitely generated.

name: Archimedean Property
statement: For any x, there exists n in N with n > x.

name: Well Ordering Principle
statement: Every nonempty subset of natural numbers has a least element.

name: Division Ring
statement: A ring where every nonzero element has a multiplicative inverse.

name: Derivative Power Rule
statement: d/dx (x^n) = n * x^{n-1}.

name: Integral Linearity
statement: integral(f + g) = integral(f) + integral(g).

name: Cauchy Sequence Convergence
statement: Every Cauchy sequence in a complete metric space converges.

name: Complete Metric Space
statement: A metric space where every Cauchy sequence converges.

name: Uniform Continuity
statement: f is uniformly continuous if for every eps there exists delta independent of x.

name: Lipschitz Continuity
statement: f is K-Lipschitz if d(f(x),f(y)) <= K * d(x,y) for all x,y.

name: Open Ball is Open
statement: The open ball B(x,r) is an open set in a metric space.

name: Composition of Limits
statement: If f → L and g → M then g(f) → g(L) when g is continuous.

name: Measurable Set
statement: A set in the sigma-algebra of a measurable space.

name: Absolute Convergence implies Convergence
statement: If sum |a_n| converges then sum a_n converges.

name: Uniform Limit Theorem
statement: Uniform limit of continuous functions is continuous.

name: Bounded Continuous Function
statement: A continuous function with bounded range.

name: Matrix Transpose
statement: A^T swaps rows and columns: (A^T)_{ij} = A_{ji}.

name: Diagonal Matrix
statement: A matrix with nonzero entries only on the main diagonal.

name: Determinant of Transpose
statement: det(A^T) = det(A).

name: Determinant of Identity
statement: det(I) = 1.

name: Trace
statement: tr(A) = sum of diagonal entries.

name: Characteristic Polynomial
statement: det(A - tI), the characteristic polynomial of matrix A.

name: Minimal Polynomial
statement: The monic polynomial of least degree annihilating a linear map.

name: Eigenspace
statement: ker(A - lambda*I), the eigenspace for eigenvalue lambda.

name: Linear Independence
statement: Vectors v1,...,vn are linearly independent if no nontrivial linear combination equals zero.

name: Span
statement: The smallest submodule containing a given set.

name: Direct Sum
statement: V = U ⊕ W means every v = u + w uniquely.

name: Dual Space
statement: V* = Hom(V, k), the space of linear functionals.

name: Bilinear Form
statement: A bilinear map B: V x V -> k.

name: Adjoint
statement: The adjoint T* satisfying <Tv,w> = <v,T*w>.

name: Orthogonal Complement
statement: W^perp = {v : <v,w> = 0 for all w in W}.

name: Tensor Product
statement: V ⊗ W, the universal bilinear construction.

name: Exterior Algebra
statement: The algebra of alternating multilinear forms.

name: Finite Dimensional
statement: A module with a finite spanning set.

name: Dimension (finrank)
statement: The cardinality of any basis of a finite-dimensional space.

name: Quotient Module
statement: M/N is a module for any submodule N of M.

name: Quotient Group
statement: G/N is the group of cosets gN with (gN)(hN) = (gh)N.

name: Quotient Ring
statement: R/I is the ring of cosets a+I with (a+I)(b+I) = ab+I.

name: Kernel of Group Homomorphism
statement: ker(f) = {g in G : f(g) = e}.

name: Image of Group Homomorphism
statement: im(f) = {f(g) : g in G}, a subgroup of H.

name: Cyclic Group
statement: A group generated by a single element.

name: Center of Group
statement: Z(G) = {g in G : gx = xg for all x in G}.

name: Simple Group
statement: A group with no proper nontrivial normal subgroups.

name: Prime Ideal
statement: An ideal P where ab in P implies a in P or b in P.

name: Maximal Ideal
statement: An ideal M where R/M is a field.

name: Kernel of Ring Homomorphism
statement: ker(f) = {r in R : f(r) = 0}, an ideal of R.

name: Noetherian Module
statement: A module where every submodule is finitely generated.

name: Localization
statement: S^{-1}R, the ring obtained by formally inverting elements of S.

name: Integral Domain
statement: A commutative ring with no zero divisors.

name: Algebraic Extension
statement: A field extension where every element satisfies a polynomial over the base field.

name: Separable Extension
statement: A field extension where every element has a separable minimal polynomial.

name: Normal Extension
statement: A field extension where every irreducible polynomial with a root splits completely.

name: SSS Congruence
statement: Two triangles are congruent iff all three corresponding sides are equal.

name: Tangent Perpendicular to Radius
statement: The tangent to a circle at a point is perpendicular to the radius at that point.

name: Inscribed Angle Theorem
statement: An inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc.

name: Collinear iff Angle 0 or Pi
statement: Three points are collinear iff the angle at the middle point is 0 or pi.

name: Similar Preserves Angles
statement: Similar triangles have equal corresponding angles.

name: Orthocenter-Circumcenter Relation
statement: The orthocenter and circumcenter are related by reflection through the nine-point center.

name: Betweenness Distance Sum
statement: If B is between A and C then dist(A,B) + dist(B,C) = dist(A,C).

name: Reflection is Involution
statement: Reflecting twice returns to the original point.

name: Affine Independent iff Not Collinear
statement: Three points are affinely independent iff they are not collinear.

name: Diameter Distance
statement: The distance between endpoints of a diameter equals twice the radius.

name: Sphere/Circle
statement: The set of points at fixed distance (radius) from a center point.

name: Midpoint
statement: The point equidistant from two given points.

name: Convex Hull
statement: The smallest convex set containing a given set.

name: Collinear
statement: Points that lie on a single line.

name: Similarity
statement: A bijection that preserves angles and scales distances uniformly.

name: Rotation
statement: A distance-preserving transformation that fixes a center point.

name: Reflection
statement: A distance-preserving transformation that mirrors across a hyperplane.

name: Homothety
statement: A transformation that scales all distances from a center by a fixed ratio.

name: Betweenness
statement: B is between A and C if B lies on the segment AC.

name: Affine Independence
statement: Points that do not all lie in a proper affine subspace.

name: Oriented Angle
statement: The signed angle between two vectors, valued in the circle group.

name: Coplanar
statement: Points that lie in a single plane.

name: Circumradius
statement: The radius of the circumscribed circle/sphere of a simplex.

name: Excenter
statement: The center of an excircle of a triangle, opposite to a vertex.

name: Weighted AM-GM Inequality
statement: The weighted arithmetic mean is at least the weighted geometric mean.

name: De Moivre Theorem
statement: cos(a+b) = cos(a)cos(b) - sin(a)sin(b) and the analogous identity for (cos+i*sin)^n.

name: Dimension of Sum Formula
statement: dim(U+W) + dim(U∩W) = dim(U) + dim(W) for subspaces U, W.

name: Trace Invariant under Similarity
statement: tr(P^{-1}AP) = tr(A) for any invertible P.

name: Rank of Product Bound
statement: rank(AB) <= min(rank(A), rank(B)).

name: Sylow Second Theorem
statement: All Sylow p-subgroups of a finite group are conjugate.

name: Nakayama's Lemma
statement: If M = IM + N with I in the Jacobson radical, then M = N.

name: Hilbert Nullstellensatz
statement: I(V(I)) = radical(I) for ideals in polynomial rings over algebraically closed fields.

name: Going Up Theorem
statement: For an integral extension R ⊆ S, every prime of R is the contraction of a prime of S.

name: Krull Intersection Theorem
statement: In a Noetherian integral domain, the intersection of all powers of a proper ideal is zero.

name: Krull's Theorem (Maximal Ideal Existence)
statement: Every nonzero ring has a maximal ideal.

name: Correspondence Theorem (Groups)
statement: There is a bijection between subgroups of G/N and subgroups of G containing N.

name: Determinant Scalar Multiplication
statement: det(cA) = c^n * det(A) for n×n matrix A.

name: Trace of Product Commutes
statement: tr(AB) = tr(BA).

name: Characteristic Polynomial Degree
statement: The characteristic polynomial of an n×n matrix has degree n.

name: Minimal Polynomial Divides Characteristic
statement: The minimal polynomial of a matrix divides its characteristic polynomial.

name: Similar Matrices Same Characteristic Polynomial
statement: If B = P^{-1}AP then charpoly(A) = charpoly(B).

name: Orthogonal Complement Dimension
statement: dim(W) + dim(W^perp) = dim(V) for subspace W of inner product space V.

name: Adjoint of Composition
statement: (ST)* = T*S* for linear maps S, T.

name: Positive Definite iff Eigenvalues Positive
statement: A Hermitian matrix is positive definite iff all eigenvalues are positive.

name: Change of Basis
statement: Matrix of composition equals product of matrices: [ST]_B = [S]_B [T]_B.

name: Eigenvalues of Hermitian are Real
statement: All eigenvalues of a Hermitian (self-adjoint) matrix are real.

name: p-Group Has Nontrivial Center
statement: If G is a p-group then Z(G) is nontrivial.

name: Index Formula
statement: |G| = |G/H| * |H| for finite group G and subgroup H.

name: Maximal Ideal iff Quotient is Field
statement: I is maximal iff R/I is a field.

name: Prime Ideal iff Quotient is Domain
statement: P is prime iff R/P is an integral domain.

name: Maximal Ideal is Prime
statement: Every maximal ideal is a prime ideal.

name: Simple Group Characterization
statement: G is simple iff it has no proper nontrivial normal subgroups.

name: Fixed Field of Galois Group
statement: The fixed field of Gal(E/F) equals F for a Galois extension.

name: Finite Extension is Algebraic
statement: Every finite field extension is algebraic.

name: Localization is Flat
statement: Localization of a commutative ring at a multiplicative set is a flat module.

name: Bernoulli Inequality
statement: (1+x)^n >= 1 + nx for x >= -1 and n >= 1.

name: Least Upper Bound Property
statement: Every nonempty bounded-above subset of R has a supremum.

name: Supremum Bound
statement: If every element of S is <= b, then sup(S) <= b.

name: Every Field is Integral Domain
statement: Every field is an integral domain (no zero divisors).

name: Characteristic is 0 or Prime
statement: The characteristic of a ring is either 0 or a prime number.

name: Exponential is Convex
statement: The function exp(x) is convex on R.

name: Logarithm Inequality
statement: ln(x) <= x - 1 for all x > 0, with equality iff x = 1.

name: Frobenius Endomorphism is Injective
statement: The Frobenius map x -> x^p is injective in characteristic p.

name: Polynomial Derivative Product Rule
statement: (f * g)' = f' * g + f * g' for polynomials.

name: Union Bound
statement: |A ∪ B| ≤ |A| + |B| for finite sets.

name: Number of Permutations
statement: |S_n| = n!, the symmetric group on n elements has n! permutations.

name: Even Number of Odd-Degree Vertices
statement: In any graph, the number of vertices with odd degree is even.

name: Double Counting
statement: Counting edges from both sides of a bipartite graph gives equal sums.

name: Stars and Bars
statement: The number of ways to put n identical items into k bins equals C(n+k-1, k-1).

name: Chromatic Number at most |V|
statement: chi(G) <= |V(G)| for any graph G.

name: Bipartite iff No Odd Cycle
statement: A graph is bipartite iff it contains no odd-length cycle.

name: Permutation Sign is Multiplicative
statement: sgn(sigma * tau) = sgn(sigma) * sgn(tau).

name: Cayley's Theorem
statement: Every group embeds injectively into a symmetric (permutation) group.

name: Continuous Image of Compact is Compact
statement: If S is compact and f is continuous, then f(S) is compact.

name: Monotone Sequence Converges
statement: Every bounded monotone sequence of reals converges.

name: First Isomorphism Theorem (Rings)
statement: R/ker(f) is isomorphic to im(f) for any surjective ring homomorphism f.

name: Cauchy Sequence
statement: A sequence where terms eventually become arbitrarily close to each other.

name: Subgroup
statement: A subset of a group closed under the group operation and inverses.

name: Hahn-Banach Theorem
statement: Disjoint convex sets (one open) can be separated by a hyperplane.

name: Uniform Boundedness Principle (Banach-Steinhaus)
statement: A pointwise bounded family of bounded linear operators is uniformly bounded.

name: Roots of Unity
statement: The n-th roots of unity are elements x with x^n = 1.

name: Convex Function
statement: f is convex on S if f(tx + (1-t)y) <= tf(x) + (1-t)f(y) for t in [0,1].

name: Jacobson Radical
statement: The intersection of all maximal ideals of a ring.
